reviews.x: I AM IN LOVE!!! This iron is amazing! I have very thick curly hair and it’s a little course and not soft like other girls. I never used heat on my hair except sometimes a dryer with a diffuser on it. I always wore my hair curly and on days I didn’t wash I’d throw it in a bun or braid. This curler changed my life! I’ve never been able to style my hair this beautifully and it’s so damn easy!! Buy it and you will never regret it.

reviews.t: It heats up quickly and can get very hot. I use mine set at 385 degrees.  When in use, keep it moving to prevent scorchi
reviews.x: I'm very pleased with this curling iron.  It is much longer in length than any curling iron I've had in the past.  It heats up in no time and it's easy to use once you get the hang of it.  I can use it without the glove but I recommend using it with the glove until you get used to its extended length. It can get very hot depending on which setting you use.  I use mine set at 385 degrees.  A nice feature is that the temperature locks once it reaches its set point.  The ceramic coating prevents st

reviews.t: I do not recommend this iron
reviews.x: I am actually pretty disappointed with this curling iron. I bought it based on the reviews and I am very disappointed. First of all the curls do not hold for even an eight hour workday. I sit at a desk I don’t do much hair flipping and by the end of the day on my curls have fallen else. It doesn’t matter the length of time that I leave the heat on the hair no matter what I do they fall out by the end of the day and I have never had this problem with any other curling iron. On top of that the mos

reviews.t: It creates beautiful curls that last for days
reviews.x: I got this curling iron to replace my hot tools iron that I had been holding onto for over ten years so it had a lot to live up to!  It heats up quickly and I appreciate that the button "locks" while in use once you've chosen your temperature- no turning it off by accident while I do my hair (I have this problem with another hair tool I own).  It creates beautiful curls that last for days.  I have thick long hair and can curl big sections with no problem.

reviews.t: Clip does not hold hair on iron.
reviews.x: The clip that holds your hair on the iron is too loose and your hair slides out too easily. Also when you set on counter, it is too long and does not sit up, it leans forward. I tried it on my hair and it did not make a tight curl when used the same way as my other similar iron.

There’s absolutely no weighting in the back half of the iron so it falls forward so that the hot iron portion is sitting flat on the counter. It made several burn marks in my bathroom counter which I’m sure I’ll have to pay to replace.

This is wonderful curling iron. Things I love about it are: - Heats up extremely quickly - Has a lighted digital heat display which is adjustable - Has a very long barrel - Extremely smooth - my hair glides right through it The glove and clips are helpful. The item arrived quickly and was a good price. I have had the item for a couple of months and I would highly recommend it!

reviews.t: but she went to study in Europe for a year and the air straightened out her hair or something like that. According to he
reviews.x: Gave to my sister. She used to have curly hair, but she went to study in Europe for a year and the air straightened out her hair or something like that. According to her this works well for when she wants to go curly top again.
Bought this to use during my trip to Iceland. It worked great there and I loved it so much it is now my go to curling iron at home as well. Love the extra long barrel.
Great tool & I love that it has the international voltage range for traveling :) !

I am very pleased with my purchase and the curls this new curling iron creates. My hair is fine and not thick or thin. It’s length is just below the shoulders with long layers, the shortest layers are about chin length. I’ve been growing out a short A-line bob with blunt bangs for nearly two years and have technically gone without a style all this time. This iron creates the prettiest and softest natural looking curl and is so easy to maneuver around my tresses. My only regret is that I didn’t h

I love Love Love this curling iron. It is so freakin cute. I couldn’t find a good 1.5 inch curling iron, but this one works great. And perfect for the beach loose waves vibe I was going for. I don’t really need the glove since the tip isn’t hot, but I really like that they included clips. I would recommend this product through and through.

I love this curling iron! Especially for the price. Looks expensive and I love the unique rose gold color. It heats up quick and curls are so big and stays long. I’m giving it 1 less star though coz it’s a little too long for me, or maybe my hair is just not long enough for this. But overall, good product👌🏼!

I just cut my hair short and wanted to achieve those messy curls everyone is hyped about. This is the perfect tool to do so. It’s super easy to use, especially speaking as someone who hasn’t used a curling iron before. It also came with a heat protecting glove and 2 hair clips which is super helpful!

reviews.t: Great product.  FOLLOW THE DIRECTIONS, IT'S H.O.T.
reviews.x: Nicely packaged, cane tight on time.  Awkward to wear a glove to curl your hair so the first thing I did was burn the cr*p out of my thumb.  (That being said, I was earned) Would be much better to have a heat proof stop or shield on the barrel.  Love the digital heat sensor.  Big barrel is nice.

Wow!! I love this curling iron! Can't say enough good things about it. Very durable and of great quality. Longer barrel than most other curling irons.  Hoping this will last me for many years. Heats up quickly and has multiple temperature settings for just the one your hair needs.  I LOVE IT!!!

It worked really great when I was in Italy. It overheated and began smoking when I was in England. It stopped working and I just threw it out :/ I was disappointed since it is suppose to be dual voltage. I hope I can get my money back or atleast get a replacement

The description states that it is dual voltage but the instructions included with the product say nothing about being dual voltage. Im returning this because I don’t want to be away on vacation and not have this appliance work correctly.

Sooooo pretty, really nice looking curling iron and nice size barrel BUT  Barrel does not hold my hair Does not curl my hair Temp fluctuates because you cant help but touch the dial when curling your hair  Unfortunately will return.

I love this curling iron! The handle did not get heated and the wand did not break my hair off. The curling iron is well constructed with many temperature settings to choose from. I would highly recommend this product!
Love this better then my hot tools brand. Ive been a hair stylist for 10 years and I have to say I’m very happy with this iron. It’s a little bit of a longer barrel but that’s perfect for long hair
This curling iron is just what I needed. It is easy to adjust the heat and it heats up fast. Easy to use.  There wasn't a heat-resistant glove included in the package but I don't need it.

reviews.t: Great and easy to use curling iron
reviews.x: So far so good, I've used it twice since it arrived. This curling iron is great for long thick hair, it made large flowing curls that are loose and help eliminate frizzies.
Very large. Only thing i wish is that it would stay down and not push the hot tip down because its "top heavy" I had to add some weight to the cord to pull it down
Gets hot in a minute or less, and allows me to curl my hair very quickly. The plastic attachment on the end of the wand makes it easy to handle without burning myself.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how quickly the iron heats up and its adjustable high heat.
Many reviewers love the extra-long barrel, though a few find it too long or awkward.
Several reviewers report that curls hold well and last a long time.
Some reviewers complain the iron tips forward and can burn counters because it lacks back-end weighting.
A few reviewers note the clip is too loose and curls don't hold or form tightly.
